name: Alternate Assist Mod
description: Manual-activity-gated adaptive Ship assistance. Synthetic press/release pulses fill gaps between real clicks, align with manual input ownership, and stop when clicking stops.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Ship Assist
assist-enabled.description: Enables Ship assistance. Assistance only runs during a short window refreshed by your real clicks; it does not autopilot while idle.

assist-profile.name: Assistance Profile
assist-profile.description: Extreme uses a narrow velocity band; Semi and Light allow progressively more vertical drift. Custom uses the Custom Deadzone slider.

custom-deadzone.name: Custom Deadzone
custom-deadzone.description: Maximum gravity-relative vertical velocity error tolerated before the controller changes the Ship input. Lower values aim for a straighter path but can cause more frequent corrections.

max-cps.name: Maximum CPS
max-cps.description: Caps complete automatic press/release cycles per second. Actual CPS is adaptive and usually lower. Higher values allow faster corrections.

target-vertical-velocity.name: Target Vertical Velocity
target-vertical-velocity.description: 0.0 aims for horizontal flight. Positive/negative values intentionally allow a small average climb or descent in gravity-relative coordinates.

manual-resume-delay.name: Manual Resume Delay
manual-resume-delay.description: Delay before automatic corrections can fill the gap after a physical click is released.

player2-enabled.name: Enable Player 2 Assist
player2-enabled.description: Enables the same Ship controller for Player 2 in dual mode. Disabled by default.

manual-activity-window.name: Manual Activity Window
manual-activity-window.description: How long assistance remains armed after your latest real click. Continued clicking refreshes the window; when you stop clicking, assistance stops.

input-alignment.name: Manual Click Alignment
input-alignment.description: Uses your recent click cadence to tighten the velocity tolerance as you click faster. Manual clicks always take priority and are never cancelled by automatic pulses.
